keyFindings.description: htmlEnd ends a tag at the first '>' and ignores quoted attribute values, so --write cuts and joins inside an inline tag (`<abbr title="a>b. Second…">` is cut after 'b.'; `title="x>y\nz"` is joined to 'x>y z'), exit 0; the render guard folds whitespace in inline html values (:796), so it lets the write through. Reproduced. Fix: skip quoted attribute values in htmlEnd; compare inline html values exactly in renderedForm; add a unit test.

A multi-line setext heading is re-laid out as a paragraph (`Setup. Then run
the tool
===` becomes `Setup.
Then run the tool`, exit 0); check mode reports R1 on it; the guard folds heading text. Where the soft break falls in a heading changes its GitHub anchor slug [INFERENCE from GitHub's slug rule that drops non-word characters]. Fix: leave a paragraph that ends at a setext underline as it is, in check and --write.

Two front matter definitions disagree: scanBlocks accepts only an exact '---' opener and closes on '---' or '...'; CLOSED_FRONT_MATTER (:88) allows trailing whitespace and closes only on '---'. A file opening '--- ' gets R1 findings inside its YAML and --write refuses the whole file (exit 2, 'a yaml became a yaml'), leaving its body's R1 unfixable by the recipe. Fix: one definition.
